reasons: Candidate applies rate() to the monotonic sum, but the Datadog query averages the raw postgresql.index_scans value, which is a cumulative count. The quantities differ (per-second rate vs. cumulative count) and so do the units.
Candidate uses the fixed range [5m]; the converter may only use [$__rate_interval].

Candidate drops the $db (tag prefix db -> postgresql_database_name, observed) and $host (tag prefix host -> host_name, observed) matchers, so it returns a different set of series than the Datadog request.
Grouping label postgresql_index_name does not appear in the observed dataset labels for this metric, so the by-clause cannot be verified against the dataset.
$scope has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct; $table is unused in the query.
